summary_en: FY2027 guidance (ended Mar 2027): annual dividend raised to 82 yen/share (41 + 41 mid-term + year-end) from prior 80 yen, reflecting upward net profit revision from 9.0 to 9.5 billion yen. Policy target: DOE 5%+ and payout ratio 50%+ with progressive dividends.
title_en: Notice on Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ended March 2027
translation_en_brief: T.RAD Co., Ltd. announced a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2027. The company raised its annual dividend per share from 80 yen (40 yen mid-term + 40 yen year-end, previously announced April 27, 2026) to 82 yen (41 yen + 41 yen), an increase of 2 yen per share. This revision follows an upward adjustment to consolidated net profit attributable to parent shareholders from 9.0 billion yen to 9.5 billion yen, driven by improved revenue projections (up 2.0 billion yen to 165.0 billion yen) and enhanced profitability from material-cost pass-through in the domestic segment and solid overseas performance. The company's stated dividend policy targets dividend on equity (DOE) of 5% or more, a payout ratio of 50% or more, and progressive dividend growth while maintaining financial soundness and steady growth investment. Note: the company executed a 1-for-10 stock split effective July 1, 2026; the stated dividend figures reflect post-split per-share amounts.
